■ Stage Direction
Looks over
With a neutral expression, notices the Trainer looking awkward

Yes. Indeed.
I am glad.

Um, how about you, Trainer-san?
Are you... doing well?
—Right as I thought that, the alarm signaling the end of the break went off.

There's an awkward air between us.
I have to fill this silence somehow—!

I see... First, to solidify the foundation,
we will focus on strength training and cardiopulmonary enhancement.
If so, I am glad to hear it.

Ever since finalizing our contract, our communication has been solid,
and training has been progressing smoothly.

With an awkward air still lingering, training resumed.
I feel like I failed to help her properly relax...

Yes. As you can see,
my training has been proceeding smoothly, but—

...I didn't know what to say, but tried to force something out anyway,
and it ended up coming out completely clumsy...

Gulp, gulp, gulp...
—...Phew.

It is time.
Shall we resume training?
...This time right here is the hardest part of all!!
Y-Yes.

If that is the case, please do not hesitate to tell me.
I will make every effort to improve.

Air Messiah took it completely literally. But
that wasn't what I meant—it was supposed to be a greeting, or small talk, or something...

I shall give it my utmost focus.
—Excuse me, then.

Yes.
I felt the same way.
(Beep beep beep, beep beep beep)

Oh no, I've made her feel obligated to be considerate.
As the adult here, I need to handle this properly—
Could it be that my performance was lacking in some way...?
However...

I was reminded once again of my own weakness—my complete lack of small talk skills.
This is a challenge I'll have to overcome moving forward...
A short while later, break time arrived.
